Name: Sled Valley
Author: LUCASGATICA
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Sled Valley[/b][/size]
[size=4][i]Sled races through the streets of Pelican Town, and a Grand Prix on the eve of the Feast of the Winter Star.[/i][/size]

[size=3]Drifts, mini-turbos, slipstreams, Winter Star gifts to throw at your neighbours, and seven villagers who really want to win.[/size][/center]

[line]

[size=5][b]What is it?[/b][/size]

Sled Valley turns Pelican Town into a snowy race circuit. Think of a top-down kart racer, but the karts are sleds, the track runs past Pierre's, JojaMart and the museum, and the rivals are Abigail, Sam, Haley and the rest of the town.

It's a standalone SMAPI mod: [b]no other mod is needed[/b], and it works with Stardew Valley Expanded.

[line]

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]❄ The race[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]3 laps, 8 sleds:[/b] you against 7 villagers, on a snow circuit with guardrails, laid over the real town map.[/*]
[*][b]Drift and mini-turbo:[/b] hold the drift through a bend and let go for a burst of speed.[/*]
[*][b]Rocket start:[/b] time your throttle on the countdown.[/*]
[*][b]Slipstream:[/b] tuck in behind a sled to fill a gauge and slingshot past it.[/*]
[*][b]Ramps with tricks[/b] and a [b]deep-snow shortcut[/b] behind the graveyard.[/*]
[*][b]Winter Star gifts:[/b] Coffee, Triple Espresso, Snowball, Homing Snowball, Sap, Frozen Tear, Orbiting Presents and the Wizard's Blizzard.[/*]
[*][b]Villagers at the roadside:[/b] Vincent and Jas lob snowballs, and Linus keeps a snowman sliding across the street.[/*]
[*][b]Live commentary[/b] by Gus in practice and by Lewis at the Grand Prix, on a broadcast card with a blinking LIVE light.[/*]
[*][b]Slow-motion photo finish[/b] when you cross the line within half a second of a rival.[/*]
[*][b]Three difficulties[/b] (Relaxed, Standard, Challenging) and [b]two steering modes[/b] (Directional: hold where you want to go; Classic: left/right to turn).[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Two circuits[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Pelican Town Loop[/b] (218 tiles a lap): drawn to fit Stardew Valley Expanded's town too.[/*]
[*][b]Village Loop[/b] (245 tiles a lap): built for the vanilla town, with a squeeze past Pierre's corner, a long run to the north bridge and two U-turns.[/*]
[*]The mod picks the right one for your town by itself. Each circuit keeps its own lap record and ghost.[/*]
[/list][b][size=4] Time trial with a ghost[/size][/b]
Press [b]Train[/b] to race alone with a Triple Espresso, chasing a see-through sled that drives your best lap. Every lap shows your split against the record.

[b][size=4] The Eve Grand Prix (Winter 24)[/size][/b]
A new yearly festival in Pelican Town, decorated for the Feast of the Winter Star (9:00 to 14:00). Lewis sends you a letter the day before, every villager has something to say, and the race ends with a podium ceremony and a prize for the champion.

[size=4][b] Your sled[/b][/size]
[b]9 paints and 7 ornaments[/b] (sleigh bells, string lights, checkered flag, reindeer antlers, garland, the Eve Star...) earned by racing: podiums, lap records, wins on Challenging and the Grand Prix. Point at any of them in the garage to try it on, even the locked ones. Purely cosmetic.

[size=4][b]The Sled Valley book[/b][/size]
Press [b]F7[/b] to open a winter photo album with four tabs:
[list]
[*][b]Race:[/b] the circuit, your best lap, difficulty, steering, your rivals, and the [b]Race![/b] and [b]Train[/b] buttons.[/*]
[*][b]Sled:[/b] the garage.[/*]
[*][b]Roadmap:[/b] what's in the game and what's coming next.[/*]
[*][b]More:[/b] controls, how to report a bug, and the settings.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]How to play[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Load a save and press [b]F7[/b].[/*]
[*]Choose the difficulty and steering on the [b]Race[/b] tab, and your look on the [b]Sled[/b] tab.[/*]
[*]Click [b]Race![/b] Your farmer goes to Pelican Town, the countdown starts, and when it's over you're back where you were.[/*]
[/list]
Practice races only save your lap records and unlocked sleds. They're single-player.

[b]At the Eve Grand Prix[/b] (Winter 24), chat with the villagers, then talk to Lewis by the start line [b]twice[/b], pick your steering and sled, and head to the grid.

[line]

[size=5][b]Controls[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Steer and accelerate:[/b] WASD / arrow keys — left stick / D-pad[/*]
[*][b]Accelerate (controller):[/b] A[/*]
[*][b]Hop and drift:[/b] Space / Left Shift — RB / RT (hold through a bend, let go for the mini-turbo)[/*]
[*][b]Use gift:[/b] J — LB / LT[/*]
[*][b]Brake and reverse:[/b] K — X / B[/*]
[*][b]Pause:[/b] Esc / P — Start[/*]
[*][b]Show or hide the controls card:[/b] Tab — Back[/*]
[/list]
All race keys can be changed in the config.

[line]

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install the latest [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Requirements:[/b] Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.0 or later.
[b]Optional:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to change the options in game.

[line]

[size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

In Generic Mod Config Menu or in [b]config.json[/b]:
[list]
[*][b]EnableMod[/b] (on): turns the whole mod on or off.[/*]
[*][b]OpenMenuKey[/b] (F7): opens the Sled Valley book.[/*]
[*][b]EnableSledRaceFestival[/b] (on): puts the Eve Grand Prix on the calendar.[/*]
[*][b]Track[/b] (Auto): which circuit to race. Auto picks the Pelican Town Loop with Stardew Valley Expanded and the Village Loop without it; Vanilla and Expanded force one.[/*]
[*][b]SledRaceDriftKey, SledRaceItemKey, SledRaceBrakeKey:[/b] the race shortcuts.[/*]
[*][b]ReducedFestivalFlashes[/b] (off): softer effects, no camera flash.[/*]
[*][b]EnableFestivalVisualEffects[/b] (on): kicked-up snow, turbo flames, confetti and other effects.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley Expanded:[/b] supported. With it you race the Pelican Town Loop, built to fit its town.[/*]
[*][b]Map mods:[/b] the track is checked against the loaded town before every race. If it doesn't fit, the other circuit is tried; if neither fits, the race moves to a fullscreen snow board, and the SMAPI log lists the blocked tiles.[/*]
[*][b]Festival mods:[/b] Sled Valley never takes a date from another mod. If something already owns Winter 24, the Grand Prix sits that year out, and a stamp on the calendar says why.[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer:[/b] the Grand Prix only appears when every player has Sled Valley 1.0.0 or later. The host races; everyone else watches and sees the same podium.[/*]
[*][b]Existing saves:[/b] safe to add to a save in progress. If you played the race in the Beach Episode test builds, your unlocked sleds, lap record, Grand Prix result and letter carry over on the first load.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]Translations[/b][/size]

English, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish and Vietnamese. Want to add your language? Copy [b]i18n/default.json[/b], translate it and send it over. You'll be credited here.

[line]

[size=5][b]Console commands[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]sledvalley menu[/b]: opens the book.[/*]
[*][b]sledvalley status[/b]: checks the track against the loaded town and says which circuit is chosen and why.[/*]
[*][b]sledvalley preview[/b]: shows or hides the track in Pelican Town.[/*]
[*][b]sledvalley festival[/b]: the Grand Prix's status.[/*]
[*][b]sledvalley festival preview[/b]: jumps into the festival for testing. [color=#e06666]It changes the session's date to Winter 24: don't sleep or save afterwards.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]Found a bug?[/b][/size]

Post in the [b]Bugs[/b] tab with your SMAPI log: load the game, reproduce the problem, then upload [b]ErrorLogs/SMAPI-latest.txt[/b] at [url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi.io/log[/url] and paste the link. The book's [b]More[/b] tab shows where to find the log.

[line]

[center][size=4]If you enjoyed racing around Pelican Town, an [b]endorsement[/b] helps a lot. Thanks for playing! ❄🛷[/size][/center]
